slice: R3 — the Agents sidebar navigation is a React surface
method: desktop source change + patch 0022 re-cut + npm run typecheck-client + node build/next/index.ts bundle --minify + copy out-vscode into the app + build-caret.ts --package + CDP read of the running Agents window + bun test apps/macos/test

problem.brief: R3 was expected to be smaller than the plan assumed because the sidebar sections already exist
problem.finding: true, but not because sections were missing: agentHomeNav.ts (created by patch 0022) already carried the reference's wording, order and commands. What it was, was 308 lines of hand-built DOM interleaved with the wiring, which is the thing R1/R2 removed from the Apps panel.

change.split: agentHomeNav.ts keeps the model and the wiring (which rows exist, what each runs, the filter state, the workspace folders, the delegated project menu) and mounts a React surface; agentHomeNavReact.ts owns the markup.
change.seam: handlers onRow(id) / onAction(id) / onFilterInput(sectionId, query) with a Map<string, () => void> in the pane, so the React surface never holds a command id it could run itself.
change.jsx: createElement, not JSX: the pinned base's src/tsconfig.json sets no jsx option.
change.classNames: unchanged, so media/agentHomeNav.css, the Caret token layer and check:cursor-parity see what they saw before.
change.patch: 0022-caret-agent-home-chrome-navigation.patch re-cut (digest fd9175913d4f4b56ef5dcf7d4969065868fc9715e2a21bddb8e254b47afe4d52) because it creates agentHomeNav.ts and now creates agentHomeNavReact.ts too.

verified.typecheckClient: cd desktop && npm run typecheck-client -> 0 errors
verified.bundle: the app's sessions.desktop.main.js contains the React surface's own literals ('caret-agent-home-nav-row selected', 'caret-agent-home-nav-section-action') and no longer contains the hand-built row factory ('button.caret-agent-home-nav-row')
verified.sidebarOnScreen: CDP: .caret-agent-home-nav present; rows newChat/search/automations/customize with the reference labels, New Chat selected with aria-current=page; Projects with the New Project action and no entries; Repositories with Filter Repositories (aria-expanded=false) and Add Repository plus the empty note 'No repository open'
verified.filterOnScreen: CDP: pressing Filter Repositories reveals input.caret-agent-home-nav-filter with placeholder 'Filter repositories'
verified.prepareDesktop: bun scripts/prepare-desktop.ts -> 'Caret desktop patches applied (27 patches, 18 removals)'
verified.patchSetApplies: bun test apps/macos/test/desktop-patch-set.test.ts -> applies every patch in manifest order onto the pinned base, tree equals the checkout
verified.rePinnedTest: apps/macos/test/ide-native-workbench.test.ts now pins the model rows instead of the old renderRow calls, pins export function mountAgentHomeNav( and the pane's runs map, and expects six diff sections in 0022

notVerified: A window with a workspace folder open: this profile has none, so the repository rows, the filter narrowing real rows and the 'No matching repository' note were not exercised with data (the toggle and input were).
Drag-reordering the project groups in the session list below the navigation.
